overview:
**High fire danger continues today across the Montrose (High Elevation) zone, driven by dry fuels (ERC 82%, BI 72%) and low humidity.**
- Danger climbs to Very High by Friday, Aug. 29, before easing back to High through the weekend.
- Warm, breezy northeast winds and dropping humidity (Min RH near 21% by Thursday) will keep fuels receptive to ignition.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for the area.
- GMUG National Forest lands moved from Stage 2 to Stage 1 Fire Restrictions on August 20, and BLM Gunnison Field Office Stage 1 restrictions remain in place across Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire near Lake City (Hinsdale Co.) is 7,257 acres, 33% contained, with area/road closures; the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,718 acres, 87% contained, with energy-infrastructure threats and closures still active.
